summary: The repair substantively resolves F001/F002/F003 with verified source + passing-test evidence, the 42-test focused suite reproduces green, Ruff is clean on the actual changed files, the 8-node differential rerun shows identical node IDs and error classes at head and baseline, all 19 claimed evidence hashes match, the handback is schema-valid, and git/push/worktree hygiene is verified. However the gate FAILS on AC-8 scope and check executability: the actual full range changes {gateway/platforms/base.py, gateway/run.py, tests/gateway/test_contractor_turns.py} and the repair delta changes {gateway/run.py, tests/gateway/test_contractor_turns.py}, while the specification's allowlist is {gateway/run.py, tests/gateway/test_contractor_turn_execution.py, tests/gateway/test_run_context.py} for the full range and {gateway/run.py, tests/gateway/test_contractor_turn_execution.py} for the repair delta. tests/gateway/test_contractor_turn_execution.py and tests/gateway/test_run_context.py do not exist at HEAD or anywhere in git history (find + git log --all), so the mandated focused pytest command exits 4 with 'file or directory not found' and runs zero tests, and the mandated ruff command warns it cannot lint them. The actual change is confined to the contractor seam and matches the 33GOD-51 quality gate's allowlist {gateway/platforms/base.py, gateway/run.py, tests/gateway/test_contractor_turns.py}; if the specification's file names are a controller-side error, correcting them and re-running this review is expected to pass on the evidence already gathered.

acceptance_criteria.evidence: Disjoint registry-derived route accepted: gateway/run.py:21294-21315 resolves profile_home and context.project_root independently with resolve(strict=True)+is_dir() and NO containment check (the c61c871 project_root.is_relative_to(profile_home) rejection was removed by 0034641); test_contractor_turn_accepts_disjoint_typed_project_root passes (my rerun: 42 passed in 2.67s). Real topology verified disjoint: ~/.hermes/agents-registry.yaml binds 33god-pm to project_path=/home/delorenj/code/33GOD while profile 33god-pm home resolves to /home/delorenj/code/33GOD/agents/hermes/pm/runtime (role.yaml: profile->runtime symlink), so the project root is an ancestor of, not contained in, the profile home. Rejections before runner/skill execution verified at run.py:21274-21285 (invalid context type, non-internal event, profile mismatch, missing command id) and 21306-21315 (missing/non-directory project root revalidated post-construction, defeating TOCTOU file replacement) with tests test_contractor_handler_rejects_untrusted_context_before_skills[3 cases] and test_contractor_turn_revalidates_project_directory_before_skills[missing,file] asserting skill loader and executor never start. Registry/wire/symlink authorization of unregistered targets is Bloodbank-side per the AC-2 ownership split; Hermes does not infer cross-process trust from directory containment.

grep -rn 'import bloodbank|from bloodbank' over gateway/, run_agent.py, cli.py, model_tools.py returns nothing; no 'bloodbank' string in gateway/run.py. gateway/platforms/base.py:2515-2520 (ContractorTurnContext docstring) assigns registry resolution and context construction to the Bloodbank adapter; Hermes revalidates the frozen typed payload (base.py:2531-2564: canonical strings, memory_policy=='none', continuity is False, non-empty unique skill tuple, absolute strict-resolved existing directory) plus filesystem facts at execution time (run.py:21294-21315). Line-by-line review of the full 97f3229..0034641 diff (446 changed lines in run.py, 89 in base.py) shows no registry client, no wire validation, and no new authority introduced in Hermes. Bloodbank consumer bloodbank/services/agent-hooks/clients/hermes.py is a generic hook publisher and contains no contractor-context construction, consistent with 33GOD-52 owning the Bloodbank-side integration.

run.py:9060 service_tier: Any = _SERVICE_TIER_UNSET (sentinel pre-existing at gateway/session_state.py:48 in base 97f3229); run.py:9114-9115 falls back to getattr(self, '_service_tier', None) ONLY on omission; run.py:9116-9120 explicit None takes the normal-tier path and never touches shared state. test_null_contractor_service_tier_is_distinct_from_ordinary_omission passes: with runner._service_tier='priority', explicit None yields request_overrides {'extra_body': {...}} while omission yields the priority override. Contractor worker resolves tier locally via _resolve_session_service_tier(source=None, session_key=None) (run.py:21142-21150) and passes it explicitly. Concurrent-turn contamination covered by test_concurrent_contractor_turns_leave_runner_config_unchanged (ThreadPoolExecutor, 2 turns) — passes.

run.py:2470 ContractorTurnCleanupFailed(ContractorTurnRejected). Success+cleanup-error path raises it at run.py:21412-21416; primary-failure path keeps ContractorTurnRejected authoritative and attaches cleanup via add_note at run.py:21401-21411; worker finally (run.py:21247-21264) runs _cleanup_agent_resources(agent, reraise=True) on every path, captures cleanup_error, and add_note's any in-flight primary exception. Platform observes FAILURE via base.py:7315-7316 on_processing_complete(ProcessingOutcome.FAILURE). Tests pass: test_cleanup_failure_raises_from_public_contractor_handler, test_cleanup_failure_marks_platform_processing_failed (asserts FAILURE not SUCCESS), test_contractor_cleanup_failure_is_observed_on_successful_turn, test_contractor_cleanup_failure_is_observed_on_failed_turn (primary RuntimeError('model call failed') preserved with cleanup note in __notes__). Cancellation cleanup still runs: CancelledError -> cancel_event.set() + _interrupt_contractor_agent (run.py:21389-21392) with the worker finally executing cleanup; test_cancellation_signals_worker_before_requesting_hard_interrupt passes.

grep for 'self\._service_tier ='/'self\._reasoning_config =' in gateway/run.py shows writes only at __init__ (7609-7610) and ordinary session paths (6013, 25961-25962) — none in the contractor path. _run_contractor_agent_sync keeps reasoning_config/service_tier in locals (run.py:21137-21150; comment '#33GOD-51' at 21146-21147) and passes them explicitly into _resolve_turn_agent_config and AIAgent. Tests test_contractor_turn_does_not_mutate_shared_runner_state and test_concurrent_contractor_turns_leave_runner_config_unchanged both pass in my independent 42-test rerun.

All 42 focused tests in tests/gateway/test_contractor_turns.py pass at HEAD in my independent rerun (42 passed in 2.67s), including the 33GOD-50/51-era behaviors: required-skill fail-closed (test_missing_required_skill_fails_before_agent_or_tool_execution, test_all_required_skills_resolve_before_any_skill_preprocessing), memory:none enforcement and memory/session_search tool-leak rejection (test_agent_is_fresh_memoryless_unpersisted_and_uses_configured_runtime, test_memory_or_history_tool_leak_fails_before_model_execution), cancellation signaling, registry eviction after success and failure, and ordinary-turn negatives. _cleanup_agent_resources default reraise=False (run.py:12394-12463) preserves ordinary-turn silent best-effort cleanup; environment/runtime resolution unchanged outside the seam per the full-range hunk review.

RED is authentic and pre-repair: red.log shows 5 failed/37 passed with tracebacks executing the c61c871 containment code (old run.py:21302 'contractor project root is outside the authorized profile boundary'), the explicit-None priority leak, DID-NOT-RAISE on cleanup failure, and platform SUCCESS instead of FAILURE — the named security/isolation/cleanup defects. GREEN: green.log '42 passed, 2 warnings' independently reproduced (42 passed in 2.67s with the review worktree's locked .venv). Ruff: 'All checks passed!' on gateway/run.py + gateway/platforms/base.py + tests/gateway/test_contractor_turns.py. Full-suite logs: hermes-gateway-head.log and hermes-gateway-base.log each contain exactly 8 FAILED lines with the same node IDs (grep -c FAILED = 8/8) and matching error classes per hermes-gateway-differential.json (whose sha256 matches the handback claim). Independent differential rerun of all 8 node IDs with the review .venv: at head 2 failed (test_session_store_default_db_uses_runtime_hermes_home, test_profile_command_reports_source_stamped_profile — both AssertionError) and 6 passed; at baseline the identical 2 failed with the identical AssertionError classes/lines and the same 6 passed; zero branch-only, zero base-only, zero error-class changes. (The 6 suite-order-sensitive failures pass in isolation at BOTH revisions; head==base under both conditions.)

SCOPE FAILS against the specified allowlist: actual full range changes {gateway/platforms/base.py, gateway/run.py, tests/gateway/test_contractor_turns.py} and actual repair delta changes {gateway/run.py, tests/gateway/test_contractor_turns.py}, while the specification allows only {gateway/run.py, tests/gateway/test_contractor_turn_execution.py, tests/gateway/test_run_context.py} full-range and {gateway/run.py, tests/gateway/test_contractor_turn_execution.py} for the delta. tests/gateway/test_contractor_turn_execution.py and tests/gateway/test_run_context.py do not exist at HEAD or in any revision (find + git log --all empty); the mandated focused pytest command exits 4 ('file or directory not found', no tests ran) and the mandated ruff command warns it cannot lint them.
